t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The games consists of harvesting mushrooms. There are gnomes who will lead you to a forest where you can harvest the mushroom. The gnomes appear in pairs of fixed colors. Each gnome in the pair will lead you to a different forest. The goal is to reach the forest that has the most mushrooms, so it is beneficial to remember which color gnome leads to which forest.

vb_textbox.text: The goal of the game is to harvest as many mushrooms as you can. There are pairs of gnomes who appear first, each one leads you to a different forest. One forest has a red basket and one has a yellow.The orange, red, blue, green gnomes vs the purple, brown, pink, yellow gnomes. Sometimes the orange, red, blue, green group of gnomes lead to a higher mushroom harvest and sometimes the other group does. The number of mushrooms keeps changing throughout the game. Pay attention to which color group leads to a higher number as you play. Remember that it constantly changes every few turns.
